verdict.rationale: Consent features are a fair question for a meeting recorder, but the evidence pack never documents participant notifications, in-meeting recording disclosure, or admin-enforced transparency settings. The material on bot vs. bot-free capture, custom meeting bots, admin view permissions, and SSO/SCIM covers adjacent capture and access-control features, not consent mechanisms.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the product ships real consent features — participant notifications, in-meeting disclosure, or admin-enforced transparency — not just a policy PDF
